error.syntax: The code can't be read in line {line}, column {column}: {message}
error.noPattern: No playable pattern found. Strudel code usually contains lines like $: s("bd sd").

note.tempoAdjusted: Tempo {original} BPM was set to {bpm} BPM (whole numbers from 40 to 220).
note.tempoNotConstant: The tempo {code} isn't a fixed number – using {bpm} BPM.
note.samplesDropped: Sounds from {code} aren't loaded – strudelmixr only uses freely licensed sounds, unknown sounds were replaced.
note.statementDropped: Line {line} ({code}) doesn't play anything and was left out – no change in sound.
note.notPlayed: Line {line} ({code}) isn't played by Strudel (only $: patterns are) and was left out – no change in sound.
note.variableInlined: Variable „{name}“ was inserted where it's used – sounds like the original.
note.muted: This track was muted in the original, so it's imported muted.
note.overwritten: The name „{name}“ is used again later and Strudel only plays the last one – this track is imported muted.
note.drums: Drum pattern turned into a step grid (kit „{kit}“) – same rhythm.
note.drumKits: The drum rows used different drum machines – the grid uses kit „{kit}“ for all of them.
note.melody: Melody turned into a note grid ({root}{octave} {scale}) – same notes.
note.chords: Chord progression turned into a chord block – same chords.
note.sample: Sample pattern turned into a sample block – same pattern.
note.codeSource: Kept as code (sounds like the original): {code}
note.codeBlock: Kept as code block (sounds like the original): {code}
note.gainClamped: Volume {gain} is outside 0–1 – set to {volume}, so it sounds a bit different.
note.gainPattern: The changing volume {code} is kept as a code block (as velocity) – sounds like the original.
note.gainVelocity: Volumes inside the code were rewritten as velocity, so the track volume doesn't override them – sounds like the original.
note.sound: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with „{to}“, so it sounds different.
note.bank: Drum machine „{from}“ replaced with kit „{to}“ – same rhythm, different drum sounds.
note.drumSound: Drum sound „{from}“ replaced with „{to}“ from kit „{kit}“ – sounds different.

recipe.distortedGuitar: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like a distorted guitar (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.cleanGuitar: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like a plucked guitar (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.synthBass: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like a synth bass (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.bass: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like a bass (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.organ: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like an organ (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.pad: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like strings or a pad (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.brass: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like a wind instrument (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.flute: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like a flute (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.bells: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like a bell or mallet (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.lead: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like a synth lead (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.
recipe.generic: Sound „{from}“ isn't available – replaced with a {to} sound shaped like a fading instrument (extra blocks right after the source) – sounds similar, not identical.

visualsDropped.one: 1 display function ({names}) left out – it makes no sound.
visualsDropped.other: {count} display functions ({names}) left out – they don't make any sound.

note.preludeKept: Setup code kept (own functions: {names}) – you'll find it above the tracks.
note.preludeKeptPlain: Setup code kept (constants and settings) – you'll find it above the tracks.
note.noteMelody: Notes turned into a melody block ({root} {scale}, octave {octave}) – same notes as the original.

arrangement.one: Song structure with 1 section taken over ({tracks} instruments) – you'll find it above the tracks.
arrangement.other: Song structure with {count} sections taken over ({tracks} instruments) – you'll find it above the tracks.

note.arrangementCode: The song structure (arrange) stays one code track: {reason} can't be split into instruments – sounds like the original.
note.instrumentUnused: Instrument „{name}“ isn't used in the song – imported muted.
note.samplesSlots: Samples from {code} are replaced by your own sample slots.
